mlm:name: SegEarth-R1
description: SegEarth-R1 is a language-guided segmentation model for remote sensing that supports geospatial pixel reasoning from implicit natural language queries, integrating a hierarchical visual encoder, LLM for instruction parsing, and a tailored mask generator for spatial correlation. It achieves SOTA on geospatial pixel reasoning and referring segmentation tasks.
masking_strategy: No mask tokens; description embedding directly used as query for mask generator
pretraining: Visual encoder and mask generator initialized with pretrained weights from Mask2Former; LLM initialized from Phi-1.5
domain_knowledge: Aggressive visual token compression for ultra-high-resolution images
Description projection module for language and multi-scale feature fusion
Streamlined mask prediction pipeline for direct description embedding queries
backbone_modifications: Progressive feature hierarchy construction for multi-scale feature maps
Stacked convolutional blocks and Layer Normalization as token compression connector

benchmarks.application: Implicit language-guided segmentation in remote sensing
benchmarks.split_ratio: 2371 train / 1135 val / 1928 test; samples used: 5434 of 5434 (100%)
